शेल् शेल् (also written सेल्), cl. 1. P. शे-
लति, Caus. Aor. अशिशेलत्, to go, move
about; to shake, tremble.
सेल् सेल्, cl. 1. P. सेलति, &c. = rt. शेल्, q. v.

शेलु शेलु, उस्, m. a kind of plant or small
tree, Cordia Myxa; a kind of fruit.

सेलु सेलु, उस्, m. the tree Cordia Myxa
(see शेलु); N. of a river.
सेल्हार सेल्हार, अस्, m., N. of a family.
